2126450722526900485.en_summary: @IIICapital argues people underestimate how hard it would be for AI to permanently break Bitcoin. Most bitcoin sits behind two locks: a hash hiding the public key and a signature proving ownership. Breaking one math problem leaves the other intact, giving time to upgrade.
2126450722526900485.zh_summary: @IIICapital 認為人們低估了 AI 永久破解 Bitcoin 的難度。大多數 bitcoin 受兩道鎖保護：隱藏公鑰的雜湊與證明所有權的簽名。破解一個數學問題後另一道仍在，給予升級時間。
